items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: this Japanese guy that I work with had a kind of a power metal ballad thing

ctx.x: Yeah. There’s so much going on. Well. It’s a challenge.

It’s another one of those challenges and one time this Japanese guy that I work with had a kind of a power metal ballad thing. And he said I’d like to do an alternate version with just the lead vocal and fifty strings, and write whatever you want. And so now all I had was a lead vocal and I wasn’t married to the chord progression. And there was even about a twelve or sixteen bar guitar solo in the middle where now there was nothing. And I wrote like for Verkärte Nacht, Schoenberg, for those sixteen bars. And the…
Do you do all your own business as far as contracts and all that kind of thing?
